metadata.description: Product engineering skills for Claude Code: ship marketing content, review design, audit repos, keep dependencies safe, improve search and AI-answer visibility, merge and deploy the PR queue, run a weekly growth loop, and turn plans into Gantarr timelines.

plugins.name: joshghent-skills
plugins.description: Eight product engineering skills in one plugin: blogger (commits → marketing content), design-review (UI critique), sentinel (repo risk audit), warden (production-error-driven dependency patching), beacon (SEO + GEO / AI-answer visibility), conductor (merge the PR queue and ship it live), growth-review (weekly numbers to one shipped improvement), and gantarr (plan → importable Gantt timeline).
